_comment: Actor Factory convention, not read by Apify. The owner enters these values once in Apify Console > Actor > Publishing > Monetization; the Publisher prints them. Results are charged with Apify's synthetic per-item event, so keep no other per-result event. Standby (MCP) runs: users also pay the platform usage of the run, as Apify always does for Standby.

apify-default-dataset-item.title: Job
apify-default-dataset-item.description: One job returned by the search_jobs tool or a normal run, written to the dataset.

apify-actor-start.title: Actor start
apify-actor-start.description: Charged once per run by Apify; keep Apify's default price.
